Rules.InvariantScript:
With({p: Filter(Table(
    {t: If(IsBlank(gblEsId), "", "社員番号：" & gblEsId)},
    {t: If(IsBlank(gblEsName), "", "社員氏名：" & gblEsName)},
    {t: If(IsBlank(gblEsMail), "", "メール：" & gblEsMail)},
    {t: If(IsBlank(gblEsDept), "", "部署：" & gblEsDept)},
    {t: If(IsBlank(gblEsFrom) && IsBlank(gblEsTo), "", "登録日時：" & If(IsBlank(gblEsFrom), "", Text(gblEsFrom, "yyyy/mm/dd hh:mm")) & " ～ " & If(IsBlank(gblEsTo), "", Text(gblEsTo, "yyyy/mm/dd hh:mm")))}
), !IsBlank(t))},
If(IsEmpty(p), "条件なし", Concat(p, t, "　／　")))
If(gblEsOpen, "▲ 折りたたむ", "▼ 展開する")
If(IsBlank(gblEsFrom), "開始日時を選択", Text(gblEsFrom, "yyyy/mm/dd hh:mm"))

Set(gblEsDd, "");Set(gblCalVal, gblEsFrom);Set(gblCalMonth, With({b: Coalesce(gblEsFrom, Now())}, DateTime(Year(b), Month(b), 1, 0, 0, 0)));Set(gblCalX, 0.505);Set(gblCalY, 0.282);Set(gblCalTarget, "empFrom")
If(IsBlank(gblEsTo), "終了日時を選択", Text(gblEsTo, "yyyy/mm/dd hh:mm"))

Set(gblEsDd, "");Set(gblCalVal, gblEsTo);Set(gblCalMonth, With({b: Coalesce(gblEsTo, Now())}, DateTime(Year(b), Month(b), 1, 0, 0, 0)));Set(gblCalX, 0.65);Set(gblCalY, 0.282);Set(gblCalTarget, "empTo")
